author: The Infographics Show
description:
The economy looks stable on paper. Stocks are near record highs, unemployment stays low, and politicians keep saying inflation is under control.

But for millions of people, reality feels completely different. Housing is unaffordable, debt is exploding, grocery prices keep climbing, and while the government says inflation is around 3%, some economists argue the real cost of surviving for working Americans feels much closer to 9%.

So why hasn’t the system broken yet?

Because after 2008, the financial system didn’t fix the problem, it hid it.
Behind the scenes, a massive shadow banking network worth trillions is propping up zombie companies, inflating asset prices, and using opaque accounting tricks to delay the collapse. Private credit firms, off-book lending, and pretend-and-extend debt schemes are keeping failing businesses alive while ordinary people quietly sink deeper into financial stress.

title: Real Reason Why The Economy Has Not COLLAPSED Yet.
